The '''Lower Pass''' was the name given to the southern pass that crossed the [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], with [[Highmount Road]] joining it to the [[Upper Pass]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Leth Outpost]] was located at the eastern end of the pass.
